The '''Baroo Heads''' were large statues found on the coastline near the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Baroo/Legends|Baroo]] and near a [[Volcano/Legends|volcanic]] mountain on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Baroonda/Legends|Baroonda]]. The [[Baroo Coast/Legends|Baroo Coast]] [[Podracing/Legends|Podracing]] course traversed the coastline and the Baroo Heads.
